newsitem.title: USA: Nalco forms unit to serve pulp industry.
newsitem.headline: Nalco forms unit to serve pulp industry.

text.p: Nalco Chemical Co said Monday it has formed a business group to provide advanced specialty chemical products and services for the North American pulp industry.

Pulp mills must meet stringent and changing environmental requirements. As more pulp mills reuse and recycle the water used in the manufacturing process, there is a need to apply more advanced treatments so that water can maintain its operating characteristics. In addition, wastewater leaving pulp plants must meet stricter environmental standards.

Nalco has been providing products and services to help pulp mills in these areas for a number of years through its Pulp and Paper Chemicals Group. The new group is expected to offer an advanced level of expertise, Nalco said in a statement.
Nalco is the largest manufacturer and marketer of water treatment, process chemicals and services in the world.
Shares of Nalco were trading up 1/4 to 37-1/8.
